limitations: No new hands-on test was completed.
Public review reports do not establish how often recording or transcription failures occur.
The large App Store score must not erase smaller but material reliability reports.

claims.statement: Voicenotes records notes and meetings, creates transcripts and summaries, supports search and AI questions, and can reuse captured material.
The official guide lists a free Basic plan with 100 minutes of weekly transcripts and summaries, and a Pro plan at $9 per user per month when checked.
Fast capture, searchable transcripts, summaries, simple access across devices, and reuse are repeated positive themes.
Recording loss, failed uploads, cut-off transcription, invented output, and missing meeting features are material reliability concerns even though they are not the majority view.
Users value Voicenotes for quick notes and tasks but do not consistently trust it as the only record of important meetings.

scoreRationale.onboarding: The basic capture flow is repeatedly described as simple, and the free plan gives people a clear way to try it across devices.
scoreRationale.product: Quick capture, search, summaries, and note questions solve a real daily problem. Recording loss and uneven transcription are too serious for a higher score.
scoreRationale.support: Public feedback includes both helpful service experiences and unresolved reliability concerns. The evidence does not support a top support score.
scoreRationale.billing: The free plan is generous and Pro pricing is clear. Buyers should prove the capture habit and reliability before paying for unlimited use.
scoreRationale.overall: Voicenotes is strong for low-stakes capture and finding old thoughts. It is not dependable enough to be the only record of an important meeting or interview.

conflictsAndUnknowns: The App Store has a large positive rating while smaller public samples contain serious recording and transcription complaints.
No new hands-on test was completed.
Pricing and product behavior can change quickly and need future checks.
